review_text: This is a friendly neighborhood place for the guys and their wives to hang out and have a beer and some food! All my friends had been telling me about this place and I met a gentleman today that knew the address of it! It is also near my place, it’s up near Tacunan. They serve mixed drinks, beer and excellent food in a cozy atmosphere! I definitely recommend you checking this place out!
Great bar/cafe cheap beer good service, they also do this delicious cheesy pizza, they are made fresh and they are absolute superb
10/10 service, cheap prices and good food. Love the soda drinks. Recommended to several friends.
Great little cafe/bar....Very friendly owner, very good prices.....highly recommended
